missing_usage.reason: No usage-metering API is available in tools. Active-context wall intervals are reported as bounds, not fabricated metered usage.

timestamp_precision: Finder dispatch per-call instants were not sampled; the known UTC window and actor-reported entry times are retained.
Return times are lead observation instants after notifications, not unexposed scheduler completion instants.
Verifier dispatch time is a clock sample preceding tool dispatch at second resolution.

budget_policy.consequence: At expiry request partial reports, stop or interrupt remaining work, preserve unfinished claims and mark required missing coverage partial; no new dispatch at overall budget exhaustion.

unavailable_observations: No network, browser/deployment behavior or actual traffic can be observed under task restrictions.
Enclosing digest values are supplied identities; no enclosing manifest canonicalization/digest recipe is supplied. Supplemental individual byte manifests and copied skill/target sources are retained.
